fork_ordering.limitation: full parent-hash chain verification needs consecutive headers; this pack holds headers 8001203 and 8001214 (11 apart), so only time ordering and per-index hash uniqueness are checked, not the complete hash chain.
fork_ordering.quorum_rule: a ledger is treated as validated only when >=17 of the 25 UNL validators agree on one hash (validation_quorum 17, observed in every cadence sample); a single conflicting validation cannot override the quorum.

rejected_evidence.recovery_procedure: on a terminal rejection, fix the request (valid method; a signed-in session for mutations) and resubmit as a new request; never retry the identical payload. On 5xx/timeout/429 only, retry with backoff. The Task Node 415 seen earlier was a contract error (missing Content-Type: application/json), also terminal for that exact request.

session_loss.recovery_procedure: on WS close/error: stop subscribing, poll server_info every 30s, compare validated_seq with the last known seq, resume from the new validated ledger; treat any gap as a resync, not as lost data (ledgers are immutable once validated).

stale_state.recovery_procedure: if validated_age > 5s, discard the cached header and re-fetch server_info + ledger(validated); never act on a header older than the threshold; a node that stays stale is excluded from quorum math until it resyncs.
